configurations.name: Category order
configurations.source: Global template configuration coverages.categoryOrder; effective Sites may override. Shared across every category/product listing; featured_prod takes precedence. src/domain/coveragePresentation.ts

configurations.name: Product order
configurations.source: Established global template order from src/domain/coveragePresentation.ts and src/config/coverages/index.ts; preserved registered-product sequence, now explicit rather than inferred from display names. Effective-site productOrder overrides this list within categories; featured_prod takes precedence. Unlisted products retain their incoming order.

configurations.name: Category names
configurations.source: Global shared presentation, inherited from requirements/global/option-lists.json#coverage-categories; Site products.json#categories.<category>.name. Home, Coverage and About Coverage use the same effective values. Empty overrides inherit canonical content.

configurations.name: Category descriptions
configurations.source: Global shared presentation, inherited from requirements/global/content/coverage.json#coverage.category; Site products.json#categories.<category>.description. Home, Coverage and About Coverage use the same effective values. Empty overrides inherit canonical content.

configurations.name: Product names
configurations.source: Global shared presentation, inherited from requirements/global/products.json#products.content.name; Site products.json#products.<product>.name. Home, Coverage and About Coverage use the same effective values. Empty overrides inherit canonical content.

configurations.name: Product descriptions
configurations.source: Global shared presentation, inherited from requirements/global/products.json#products.content.description; Site products.json#products.<product>.description. Home, Coverage and About Coverage use the same effective values. Empty overrides inherit canonical content.

configurations.name: Product description notices
configurations.source: Global optional plain-text notice slot. Effective Site products.json#products.<product>.descriptionNotice renders in bold on a separate line after the shared product description in Coverage, quotes and offering overviews; omitted values inherit global content.

configurations.name: Applicant-specific product notes
configurations.source: Global optional notes keyed by member/spouse/child. Effective Site products.json#products.<product>.applicantNotes supplies the wording displayed above the applicable applicant controls. Wording does not itself enable a coverage rule.
